SELECT
    change_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences,
    AVG(engagement_variation) AS avg_engagement_variation
FROM (
    SELECT 
        (therapy_details->>'changes')::TEXT AS change_type,
        (therapy_details->>'engagement')::TEXT AS engagement_score,
        LAG((therapy_details->>'engagement')::TEXT) OVER (ORDER BY txkey) AS previous_engagement_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG((therapy_details->>'engagement')::TEXT) OVER (ORDER BY txkey) IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE (
                CASE (therapy_details->>'engagement')::TEXT 
                    WHEN 'High' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
                    ELSE NULL
                END - 
                CASE LAG((therapy_details->>'engagement')::TEXT) OVER (ORDER BY txkey) 
                    WHEN 'High' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            )
        END AS engagement_variation
    FROM treatmentbasics
    WHERE therapy_details->>'changes' IS NOT NULL
) AS subquery
GROUP BY change_type
ORDER BY change_type;
